title: The Limping Child — Paediatric Orthopaedics, Clubfoot and Red Flags

hook.en: A child is not a small adult. A limp in a four-year-old and a limp in a thirteen-year-old mean very different things, and a few of them cannot wait. Learn to ask the age first, then sort the limp into safe, watch and urgent.
hook.ur: Bacha chhota bara nahi hota. Chaar saal ke bache ka langar aur terah saal ke bache ka langar bilkul mukhtalif matlab rakhte hain, aur kuch intezar nahi kar sakte. Pehle umar poochhna seekhein, phir langar ko mehfooz, nigrani aur urgent mein baantein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll sort a limping child by age, spot the urgent causes (septic arthritis, slipped capital femoral epiphysis), describe the Ponseti approach to clubfoot, recognise developmental hip dysplasia and Duchenne signs, and counsel Pakistani families clearly.
goal.ur: End tak aap langarte bache ko umar se chhantenge, urgent wajuhaat (septic arthritis, slipped capital femoral epiphysis) pehchanenge, clubfoot ke Ponseti tareeqe ko bayan karenge, developmental hip dysplasia aur Duchenne ki nishaniyan pehchanenge, aur Pakistani khandanon ko saaf samjhayenge.

text.en: Children grow at **growth plates (physes)**, soft areas near the ends of long bones that are weaker than the ligaments around them. So a child's injury often hurts the plate, not the ligament, and the same joint can be hurt by different conditions at different ages. The first question for any limp is **how old is the child?** The second is **can they bear weight, and do they have fever?**
text.ur: Bache **growth plates (physes)** par barhte hain, lambi haddiyon ke sire par naram hissay jo gird ke ligaments se kamzor hote hain. Isliye bache ki chot aksar plate ko lagti hai, ligament ko nahi, aur ek hi joint alag umar mein alag halaton se mutasir hota hai. Har langar ka pehla sawal hai **bache ki umar kya hai?** Doosra hai **kya woh wazan utha sakta hai, aur bukhar hai?**

text.en: Think of a **sapling versus an old tree**. A sapling bends, splits at the soft growing tip and can regrow in a new direction. An old tree is stiff and cracks. A child's bone behaves like the sapling: it bends and fractures through the growing plate, and it can remodel, but a wrong direction early becomes a deformity later.
text.ur: **Naye paudhe aur purane darakht** ko sochein. Naya paudha mur jata hai, naram barhti nok par phat jata hai aur naye rukh mein dobara barh sakta hai. Purana darakht sakht hota hai aur tootta hai. Bache ki haddi naye paudhe jaisi hai: mur jati hai, growing plate se tooti hai, aur dobara dhal sakti hai, lekin shuru mein ghalat rukh baad mein bigaad ban jata hai.

title.en: Four-step first look at a limping child
title.ur: Langarte bache ko pehli nazar ke chaar qadam

steps.title: Age and story
steps.detail: Ask age, onset (sudden or gradual), injury, fever, recent illness, night pain and whether the child will bear weight. || Umar aur kahani

steps.title: Watch the walk
steps.detail: Look for a painful (antalgic) limp, a Trendelenburg sign or a toe-walking pattern. Check the whole leg and the spine. || Chal dekhein

steps.title: Examine the hip first
steps.detail: Check hip movement, especially internal rotation. A stiff, painful hip with fever or weight-bearing refusal needs urgent referral. || Pehle hip dekhein

steps.title: Decide: safe, watch or urgent
steps.detail: Safe: mild, short, improving. Watch: persistent over a week or recurring. Urgent: fever, cannot bear weight, severe night pain, night sweats or a sick-looking child. || Faisla: mehfooz, nigrani ya urgent

question.en: A 7-year-old boy has been limping for three weeks with mild thigh and knee pain, no fever, and reduced hip internal rotation. What should you consider and do?
question.ur: 7 saal ka larka teen haftay se halke raan aur ghutne ke dard ke saath langar raha hai, bukhar nahi, aur hip ki andar ki rotation kam hai. Kya sochna aur karna chahiye?

text.en: A hip cause such as Perthes disease; refer for medical assessment and imaging
text.ur: Perthes jaisi hip ki wajah; medical assessment aur imaging ke liye refer karein

feedback.en: Yes — knee and thigh pain with a stiff hip in this age group should make you think of the hip.
feedback.ur: Haan — is umar mein ghutne aur raan ka dard sakht hip ke saath ho to hip ke baare mein sochna chahiye.

text.en: A simple knee sprain; give knee exercises
text.ur: Ghutne ki saada moch; ghutne ki exercises dein

feedback.en: The hip is the likely source and needs checking.
feedback.ur: Hip mumkina zariya hai aur dekhna zaroori hai.

text.en: Growing pains; reassure and send home
text.ur: Barhne ke dard; tasalli dein aur ghar bhejein

feedback.en: A limp is not a growing pain.
feedback.ur: Langar barhne ka dard nahi hota.

question.en: A 12-year-old overweight boy has had knee pain and a limp for a week; his hip is held turned outwards and he cannot internally rotate it. What is the urgent concern?
question.ur: 12 saal ke mote larke ko ek haftay se ghutne ka dard aur langar hai; uska hip bahar ki taraf ghoomta hai aur andar ghooma nahi sakta. Urgent fikr kya hai?

text.en: A muscle strain; stretch the hamstrings

feedback.en: Stretching could worsen a slipped hip.
feedback.ur: Stretch slipped hip ko bigaad sakti hai.

feedback.en: Knee pain with a stiff hip is a hip problem until proven otherwise.
feedback.ur: Ghutne ka dard sakht hip ke saath hip ka masla hai jab tak ulta sabit na ho.

text.en: Slipped capital femoral epiphysis (SCFE); stop weight-bearing and refer urgently
text.ur: Slipped capital femoral epiphysis (SCFE); wazan band karein aur foran refer karein

feedback.en: Yes — SCFE needs urgent orthopaedic care and the child should not walk on it until assessed.
feedback.ur: Haan — SCFE ko urgent orthopaedic care chahiye aur bacha jaanch tak is par na chale.

question.en: A newborn is found to have a foot turned inwards and downwards, stiff, with a deep crease. What is the usual best first treatment?
question.ur: Naye paida bache ka paon andar aur neeche ki taraf mura hua, sakht aur gehri line ke saath hai. Aam taur par behtareen pehla ilaaj kya hai?

text.en: Waiting until the child starts to walk before treating
text.ur: Chalne ki umar tak ilaaj ka intezar

feedback.en: Early treatment is far more effective.
feedback.ur: Shuruaati ilaaj kahin zyada mu'assir hai.

text.en: Early gentle serial casting (the Ponseti method) started in the first weeks of life
text.ur: Shuruaati narm serial casting (Ponseti tareeqa) zindagi ke pehle haftay mein shuru

feedback.en: Yes — Ponseti casting is the first-line treatment, then a small tendon release and a brace to keep the correction.
feedback.ur: Haan — Ponseti casting pehle darje ka ilaaj hai, phir chhota tendon release aur correction qaim rakhne ke liye brace.

feedback.en: Home massage alone does not correct true clubfoot.
feedback.ur: Sirf ghar ki maalish asal clubfoot theek nahi karti.

text.en: **Dismissing the limp, or blaming "growing pains".** Real growing pains do not cause a limp, do not wake the child with severe pain in one joint and do not come with fever, swelling or a stiff hip. A limp always has a cause. Another trap is treating hip pain as a knee problem: always examine the hip in a child with knee pain.
text.ur: **Langar ko nazar-andaz karna, ya "barhne ke dard" kehna.** Asal barhne ke dard se langar nahi hota, ek joint mein shadeed dard se bacha jaag nahi jata aur bukhar, soojan ya sakht hip nahi hota. Langar ki hamesha wajah hoti hai. Ek aur jaal hip ke dard ko ghutne ka masla samajhna hai: ghutne ke dard wale bache mein hamesha hip dekhein.

text.en: **Talk to the family calmly and clearly.** For example: "A limp means something is bothering the leg, and we need to find out what. Most causes are mild, but a few need quick care, so please do not wait if there is fever, if the child will not walk, or if pain wakes them at night. Clubfoot is treatable, but it needs weekly casts and then a brace, and missing the brace is the main reason it comes back." In Pakistan, check the family can reach a children's orthopaedic service and the brace follow-up.
text.ur: **Khandan se pur-sukoon aur saaf baat karein.** Misaal: "Langar ka matlab hai taang mein kuch takleef de raha hai, aur humein wajah dhoondni hai. Zyada tar wajuhaat halki hain, lekin kuch ko jaldi care chahiye, isliye bukhar ho, bacha chalne se inkaar kare, ya raat ko dard jagaye to intezar na karein. Clubfoot ka ilaaj mumkin hai, lekin haftawar casts aur phir brace chahiye, aur brace chhorna dobara hone ki sab se badi wajah hai." Pakistan mein dekhein ke khandan bachon ki orthopaedic service aur brace follow-up tak pohanch sakta hai.

question.en: Why are boys with Duchenne muscular dystrophy often noticed first for "clumsiness" or "toe-walking"?
question.ur: Duchenne muscular dystrophy wale larke aksar pehle "bhadepan" ya "ungliyon par chalne" se kyun nazar aate hain?

answer.en: The first muscles to weaken are in the hips and thighs, so the boy climbs up his own legs with his hands to stand (Gowers sign), has a waddling gait, may have enlarged calves and walks on his toes. The condition is X-linked, so mostly boys, and a late-walking, clumsy boy deserves a muscle enzyme blood test (creatine kinase) and genetic referral.
answer.ur: Sab se pehle kamzor hone wale muscles hips aur raan mein hote hain, isliye larka khade hone ke liye apne haathon se apni taangon par chadhta hai (Gowers sign), chalne mein dolta hai, pindliyan moti ho sakti hain aur ungliyon par chalta hai. Yeh X-linked hai, isliye zyada tar larke, aur der se chalne wale, bhadde larke ko muscle enzyme ka blood test (creatine kinase) aur genetic refer chahiye.

beats.patient: A 3-month-old girl is brought by her mother, who says the baby's left leg looks shorter and the skin folds on that thigh look uneven. She was born breech and no hip scan was done.
beats.assessment: This is a risk-factor picture for developmental hip dysplasia (breech birth, girl, uneven folds). Limited hip spreading may be seen on examination.
beats.treatment: Refer promptly for a hip ultrasound; the common early treatment is a soft harness (such as a Pavlik harness) worn full time under specialist supervision. Teach the mother safe handling with hips apart.
beats.reassess: Early treatment avoids later surgery; she needs follow-up scans and repeat checks until the hip is stable.

text.en: **Urgent referral signs in a child.** Fever with a hot, painful joint, refusal to bear weight, severe night pain, a limp with weight loss or night sweats, a child who looks unwell, repeated unexplained fractures or injuries that do not match the story (consider safeguarding) all need same-day medical assessment. Do not stretch or load a limping child until the cause is known.
text.ur: **Bachon mein urgent refer ki nishaniyan.** Bukhar ke saath garam, dardnak joint, wazan utha pane se inkaar, shadeed raat ka dard, wazan kam hone ya raat ko paseene ke saath langar, bimar nazar aane wala bacha, baar baar be-wajah fractures ya chotein jo kahani se na milein (safeguarding sochein) sab ko usi din medical assessment chahiye. Wajah maloom hone tak langarte bache ko stretch ya load na karein.

text.en: In a study of children with a hot hip, four predictors helped distinguish septic arthritis from transient synovitis: not bearing weight, fever above 38.5 degrees Celsius, a raised ESR and a raised white-cell count; the more predictors present, the higher the chance of infection. These predictors need to be tested again in new populations, so use them as a guide, not a rule. The Ponseti method for clubfoot reported excellent early correction rates with serial casting, a heel-cord release in most cases and then bracing; in follow-up, poor brace adherence is the main cause of relapse.
text.ur: Garam hip wale bachon ki ek study mein chaar predictors ne septic arthritis ko transient synovitis se alag karne mein madad di: wazan na utha pana, 38.5 degree Celsius se zyada bukhar, ESR ka barhna aur white-cell count ka barhna; jitne zyada predictors hon, infection ka imkaan utna zyada. In predictors ko naye aabadi mein dobara aazmana zaroori hai, isliye inhein rehnumai samjhein, qaanoon nahi. Clubfoot ke Ponseti tareeqe ne serial casting, aksar heel-cord release aur phir bracing se behtareen shuruaati correction ki shehrat batayi; follow-up mein brace ka kam istemal dobara hone ki sab se badi wajah hai.

text.en: **Age, Weight, Fever, Hip.** Ask the age, check weight-bearing, look for fever, and always examine the hip.
text.ur: **Age, Weight, Fever, Hip.** Umar poochhein, wazan utha pane ko dekhein, bukhar dhoondein, aur hamesha hip dekhein.

summary.en: In a limping child, ask the age, check weight-bearing and fever, and always examine the hip first.
summary.ur: Langarte bache mein umar poochhein, wazan aur bukhar dekhein, aur hamesha pehle hip dekhein.

summary.en: Urgent causes such as septic arthritis and slipped capital femoral epiphysis cannot wait; refer on the same day.
summary.ur: Septic arthritis aur slipped capital femoral epiphysis jaisi urgent wajuhaat intezar nahi kar sakti; usi din refer karein.

summary.en: Clubfoot is treated early with Ponseti casting and a brace; developmental hip dysplasia needs early scanning and a harness.
summary.ur: Clubfoot ka ilaaj shuru mein Ponseti casting aur brace se hota hai; developmental hip dysplasia ko jaldi scan aur harness chahiye.
